title: K8s Manifest Generator
description: Generate Kubernetes Deployment + Service YAML from your app settings — valid multi-doc manifests.
howto: Enter the app name, image and replica count.
Set container and service ports, plus env vars.
Copy the YAML or download deployment.yaml.

faqs.a: A Deployment (with labels, selector, container port, env vars) and a Service, as two YAML documents separated by ---.
One KEY=value per line — each becomes an env entry with name and value.
Yes — standard apiVersion/v1 and apps/v1 manifests you can apply with kubectl apply -f.
